newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Denmark sees lower state budget deficits.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Denmark sees lower state budget deficits.

text.p: Denmark's Finance Ministry on Tuesday cut its estimates for the 1996 and 1997 state budget deficits to 28.5 billion crowns and 19.3 billion crowns, respectively.

The ministry's last estimates, issued with the unveiling of the government's draft 1997 state budget in August, forecast a state budget deficit this year of 31.0 billion crowns and falling to 22.6 billion crowns in 1997.
